feed_story: Painting-to-wearable launch recovery with clear sequencing: source, reconstruction, body proof, process proof, then product-led closure.
rules: Keep the first row mixed: meaning, product, body to avoid a source-heavy opening.
Separate reused distressed grommet eyelet tank top posts as much as possible and vary their narrative role.
Break dense digital/source and process posts with body or product clarity.
Use product families with low repetition where possible; prioritize underused essentials when they fit the story.
Avoid exact duplicate asset sequences and repeated same-order visual sets.
Preserve the narrative ladder: source -> reconstruction -> body -> detail/process -> product/CTA.
warnings: Row 1 in the reference set had too much dark/source weight; this grid fixes that by inserting body proof early.
Repeated distressed grommet eyelet tank top use remains unavoidable in the recovery window.
Some later posts still lean process/digital, so spacing matters to keep the grid breathable.
